title: Equipment Sets
autoTooltip: Automatically installs the saved equipment when the tank is selected. (De)activates for every tank.
downgradeTooltip: Example: Uses standard equipment if a trophy one isn't available.
alwaysSetup1Tooltip: Always selects setup 1 after installing, instead of staying on the last used setup. For technical reasons this leads to noticeably shorter install times.

importDropdownLabel: Import saved configs from kurzdor's auto equipment return
importOwnDropdownLabel: Import saved configs from another of your accounts
importOtherAccountTooltip:
{HEADER}Import only from your own account{/HEADER}{BODY}kurzdor stores his vehicles by inventory id. Those ids only mean something inside one account.
On a different account the same ids belong to different vehicles, so an import would put the equipment on the wrong tanks.

How to get the saved equipments anyway:
1. Run this mod on the original account and import the saved equipment there.
2. Then, from this account, import that account's file – via "Import saved configs from another of your accounts".{/BODY}
importOtherAccountWhy: Only the file matching your account ID (%(accountId)s) can be imported here.
importOtherAccountStep1: How to get the data across anyway: 1. Run this mod on the original account and import the saved equipment there.
importOtherAccountStep2: 2. Then, from this account, import that account's file – via the dropdown below.
importOtherAccountMsg: Cannot import %(file)s: the file belongs to account %(fileAccount)s, you are playing on %(accountId)s. kurzdor files can only be imported on the account they were written for.
importDoneMsg: Kurzdor import (%(file)s): %(imported)d vehicle(s) imported, %(skipped)d skipped (already had own sets)
importOwnDoneMsg: Import from %(file)s: %(imported)d vehicle(s) imported, %(skipped)d skipped (already had own sets), %(unmatched)d not owned on this account
importEmptyMsg: Import (%(file)s): file has no importable vehicles
syncCheckboxTooltip: Connects your account to cloud sync via a Wargaming sign-in (OAuth). Once connected, your saved equipment sets are also stored on the server and automatically synced with your other PCs.
syncModListDisableTooltip: Disconnects from cloud sync. Reconnecting later requires signing in via Wargaming (OAuth) again. Warning: disconnecting deletes all equipment sets saved on the server for this account.
syncModListDisableTooltipAslain: {BODY}Disconnects from cloud sync. Reconnecting later requires signing in via Wargaming (OAuth) again.{/BODY}{ATTENTION}Disconnecting deletes all equipment sets saved on the server for this account.{/ATTENTION}
syncPairingFailed: Could not reach the sync server.
syncPairingExpired: Pairing request expired, please try again.
syncPairingMismatch: A different account was confirmed in the browser.
syncCloudDataAvailableNotification: Equipment sets are saved in the cloud for your account. Connect via the mod list button to load them on this PC.
sharingModListTooltip: Shares your currently cloud-synced equipment sets publicly under your streamer profile, so other players can see and use them via the streamer picker.
sharingModListDisableTooltip: Stops showing your equipment to other players. Your existing cloud-synced sets are unaffected - only public visibility changes.
sharingModListDisabledTooltip: You've been invited to share your equipment publicly. Enable Equipment Cloud Sync first, then you can turn sharing on here.
